port.dtn_port_modal_reference: top=physical_z_max; bottom=physical_z_min; bottom lossy power uses boundary-plane phase attenuation
port.dtn_port_modal_amplitude_convention: auxiliary unknown a_j is the total-field port projection. top outgoing amplitude = a_j - incident_projection_j; bottom outgoing amplitude = a_j. Power uses boundary-plane outgoing amplitude after applying boundary_phase.
port.dtn_port_power_metric_note: Stage-4 dtn_port R/T is computed directly from auxiliary outgoing modal amplitudes on the finite top and bottom port faces. Selected modes with positive outward real-Poynting flux contribute even when a below-critical lossy mode retains propagating=false; lossless evanescent modes carry zero modal power.

volume.epsilon_definition: epsilon_r = n^2; the absorption integrand uses Im(epsilon_r), not Im(n)
volume.normalization_note: A_volume uses the current Stage-4 code-unit normalization: P_abs = integral 0.5*k0*Im(epsilon_r)*|E_total|^2 dV over physical material cells, divided by incident_power_code_units. PML cells and air cells are deliberately excluded from material volume absorption. The k0 factor follows from H_code=curl(E)/(i*k0*mu_r) and the corresponding Poynting balance.

REFERENCE.total_channel_coefficient_meaning: original FE tangential projection including known incident field
REFERENCE.outgoing_channel_coefficient_meaning: outgoing modal coefficient before boundary phase; known incident top projection subtracted

preassembly.kind: derived reference assembly/conversion reserve, not RSS

direct.symbolic_estimate_meaning: MUMPS INFOG(16)/(17): estimated factorization working memory maximum/sum over processes in decimal MB; MPI1; INFOG(17) plus independent conversion/workspace reserve

result.c_scattered_meaning: all independent p5 scattering FE coefficients; no background/slaves
result.alpha_scattered_meaning: original alpha(c_scattered) with layered FE background removed
result.alpha_total_meaning: background_alpha + alpha_scattered; includes known top incident projection

action.actual_blocks: [V B; -D H], A=V+B solve(H,D), f=g-B solve(H,gp)

scope.integration: Basix value/derivative physical quadrature; oriented basis, no saved F used

array_capacity.kind: derived conservative assembly/conversion overlap; not RSS
